about: Metal's full player with the peek (his call A, 2026-10-21; metal.md §6.8): the motion cases of DESK-TESTS.md §6.6 step 2 on the web demo at 1800 × 900 (the dev app was in use by another driver). Open and close, rapid open/close, Next/Back inside the player, a skin change and the Peek row while open, a resize through the stacked layout, reduced motion. A rAF sampler counts frames where the cover is not square or its box is not 5:4 (expect 0); each case ends with the geometry probe.
pass: Every expect holds; read the open and close strips by time for a jump of the cover box or a doubled cover.

shots.about: A warm-up: the first shot of a run in the app repo can time out on its page load while the demo server compiles (2026-10-21). Its result does not count.
Open by the Compass, close by the close square; the sampler runs through both flights.

steps.eval: window.__mfp = { bad: 0, n: 0, layers: 0, on: true }; (function tick() { const a = document.querySelector('[data-slot="np"] .np__art'); const v = a && a.querySelector(':scope > .vinyl:not(.vinyl--out)'); if (a && v) { const r = a.getBoundingClientRect(), q = v.getBoundingClientRect(); __mfp.n++; const peek = document.documentElement.dataset.metalPeek !== undefined; if (Math.abs(q.width - q.height) > 3 || (peek && Math.abs(r.width / r.height - 1.25) > 0.03)) __mfp.bad++; if (a.querySelectorAll(':scope > .vinyl').length > 2) __mfp.layers++; } if (__mfp.on) requestAnimationFrame(tick); })();

steps.probe: (() => { __mfp.on = false; return { bad: __mfp.bad, layers: __mfp.layers, sampled: __mfp.n > 30, closed: !document.querySelector('.bento[data-player="full"]') }; })()

shots.about: Open, close 250 ms later, open again 250 ms later: the last state wins and lands square.

steps.probe: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('.bento[data-player="full"] .panel[data-slot="np"]'); if (!p) return { open: false }; const q = (s) => p.querySelector(s)?.getBoundingClientRect(); const v = q('.np__art > .vinyl'), a = q('.np__art'), m = q('.np__meta') || q('.np__center'), c = p.getBoundingClientRect(); return { open: true, coverSquare: !!v && Math.abs(v.width - v.height) < 2, bandMatchesCover: !!(v && m) && Math.abs(v.left - m.left) < 2 && Math.abs(v.width - m.width) < 2, boxInCard: !!a && a.left >= c.left - 1 && a.right <= c.right + 1, box54: !!a && Math.abs(a.width / a.height - 1.25) < 0.02 }; })()

shots.about: Inside the open player: Next, Back, Next, Back 250 ms apart (the zoetrope turn), ending on the starting song.
